invariants.rationale: The method immediately calls operationType.equals() so operationType must not be null.
table is dereferenced via table.getInstantGenerator() and passed into other methods; must be non-null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used in method calls with containsInstant(), so it must not be null.
instantTime is passed in to getCompactionInflightInstant(), so it must be non-null.
The method throws UnsupportedOperationException if operationType is LOG_COMPACT; thus, this invariant should hold whenever preconditions are met.
